text: wavelength axis attached attribute. nominal axis camera, 500–995 nm 5 nm steps across native 100 bands; file stores wavelengths. array ordinary R data, base graphics enough first look. Row 1 top image, y axis runs downwards. bundled example synthetic 16 × 12 pixel cube eight bands: disc higher reflectance diagonal gradient. colour key gives scale.  Reading subset bands often enough, instance building RGB composite: wavelength axis must assumed, instance another camera model, tivis_read_cube_profiled() reads samples records axis came : either declare , stays NA.
code: cube <- tivis_read_cube(f) dim(cube) #> [1] 12 16  8 range(attr(cube, "wavelengths")) #> [1] 500 535 head(tivis_get_wavelengths(100L)) #> [1] 500 505 510 515 520 525 wl <- attr(cube, "wavelengths") band <- cube[, , 4] disc <- band > mean(range(band)) pal <- hcl.colors(64, "viridis")  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE) layout(matrix(1:3, nrow = 1), widths = c(3.8, 0.95, 3.25))  # band image: x is the column, y the row, with row 1 at the top par(mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.6, 0.6), cex = 0.85) image(   x = seq_len(ncol(band)), y = seq_len(nrow(band)), z = t(band),   ylim = c(nrow(band) + 0.5, 0.5), col = pal, useRaster = TRUE,   yaxt = "n", xlab = "Column (x)", ylab = "Row (y)",   main = sprintf("Reflectance, band 4 (%d nm)", wl[4]) ) axis(2, at = c(1, 4, 8, 12), las = 1)  # colour key for the band image par(mar = c(4.2, 0.4, 2.6, 3.4), cex = 0.85) key <- seq(min(band), max(band), length.out = length(pal)) image(   x = 1, y = key, z = t(key), col = pal, useRaster = TRUE,   axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "" ) axis(4, las = 1) box()  # mean spectra of the disc and of everything else par(mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.6, 0.8), cex = 0.85) spectrum <- function(mask) apply(cube, 3, function(b) mean(b[mask])) plot(   wl, spectrum(disc), type = "b", pch = 16, col = "#0072B2",   ylim = c(0, 0.5), las = 1,   xlab = "Wavelength (nm)", ylab = "Mean reflectance", main = "Mean spectra" ) lines(wl, spectrum(!disc), type = "b", pch = 17, lty = 2, col = "#D55E00") legend(   "bottomright", legend = c("Disc", "Background"), pch = c(16, 17),   lty = c(1, 2), col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"), bty = "n" ) par(op) rgb_bands <- tivis_read_cube(f, bands = c(1L, 3L, 5L)) dim(rgb_bands) #> [1] 12 16  3 attr(rgb_bands, "wavelengths") #> [1] 500 510 520 undeclared <- tivis_read_cube_profiled(f) attr(undeclared, "wavelength_evidence") #> [1] "unavailable" attr(undeclared, "wavelengths") #> [1] NA NA NA NA NA NA NA NA  declared <- tivis_read_cube_profiled(f, wavelengths = seq(500, 535, by = 5)) attr(declared, "wavelength_evidence") #> [1] "caller_declared"

title: tivis.r
text: TIVITA publish specification, format determined empirically: header decodes 640, 480, 100 file size equals 12 + 640 × 480 × 100 × 4 exactly. Big-endian float32 gives physically plausible reflectance non-finite values; little-endian gives thousands NaN. two ordering questions settled measuring sample stream directly rather guessing. Autocorrelation raw stream peaks lag 100 (r = 0.95) — band count — harmonics 200, 300 400, signature band interleaving pixel. Autocorrelation single extracted band plane peaks lag 480 (r = 0.99), image height, r = 0.43 lag 640, width: pixels run columns, across rows. Rendering ordering produces sharp clinical image; every combination produces tiling, striping noise.

Getting wrong easy miss, array() recycles silently: reader wrong ordering still returns full-size, plausible-looking cube. tivis_read_header() therefore validates file size header, tests pin x/y mapping asymmetric feature rather round-tripping writer reader — let earlier error pass green suite.
